title: Combined Unsecured Exposure Share for FlexLine Limit Increases
content:
**Rule.** The exposure share scales a FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit limit increase by the borrower's combined Larkspur unsecured credit, the current credit limit plus the unpaid principal of the borrower's active Personal Loans loan (the one recorded first when there are two): 30000.00 USD or more gives 0.75; 15000.00 USD or more but below 30000.00 USD gives 0.90; below 15000.00 USD, or with no active personal loan, gives 1.00.

The share multiplies the increase before it is added to the current credit limit and the sum rounded down.

**Records read.** The borrower's Personal Loans: which loan is active and its unpaid principal balance.

| Current limit plus active personal-loan principal | Share |
|---|---|
| 30000.00 or more | 0.75 |
| 15000.00 to below 30000.00 | 0.90 |
| below 15000.00 | 1.00 |
| no active personal loan | 1.00 |

*Hypothetical cases:* a 12000.00 USD limit and 18000.00 USD of principal give exactly 30000.00 USD, so 0.75; a 6000.00 USD limit and 8999.99 USD of principal give 14999.99 USD, so 1.00.
